description_en: This Bāhāḥ is located in Ikāchẽ Ṭola and is a private Bāhāḥ founded in 1678 (NS 798) by Bekhādeva Vajrācārya, a member of the Ikāchẽ Bāhāḥ (LAL0950). Bekhādeva was one of the sons of Tuhūdeva Vajrācārya, the founder of Ālko Hiti. When the sons of Tuhūdeva divided their properties up, the three brothers inherited three different monuments. One received Ānā Bāhāḥ and its land, the other Ālko Hiti and its land, and the last one the Āgama deity and its land. The descendants of the son who received Ānā Bāhāḥ made are still running it today.The two-storey esoteric god-house of the Bāhāḥ faces east. Corrugated zinc sheets cover the roof of the building, which is supported by plain struts, and acaitya-shaped cement pinnacle surmounts it. A metal flag has been fixed on top of the pinnacle. The upper storey of the building has a triple opening window in the center which is flanked by two ordinary windows. (Locke1985, 50) mentions that there was a repouseetoraṇadepicting the Buddha, Dharma and Saṅgha above this window. However, thetoraṇasthat currently sit over each window are all made of clay.The sanctum sanctorum of the monastic building is located on the ground floor and houses a statue of Akṣobhya. A pair of stone lions flank the stairs leading to the sanctum, and a woodentoraṇashowing an image of Akṣobhya and the Five Buddhas has been installed above the entrance. This newtoraṇawas made in 1980 after the loss of the old one. Small statues of Gaṇeśa and Mahākāla flank the door, as do two prayer wheels. The ground floor façade of the shrine has a ceramic tile facing. AnaśokaCaitya, a Dharmadhātu Maṇḍalaand a Mañjuśrī Pādukā (resembling the feet of Mañjuśrī) can be found in the courtyard. The Caitya was consecrated before the foundation of the Bāhāḥ and renovated in 1657.The descendants of Bekhādeva have been running the Bāhāḥ. Saṅgharatna Vajrācārya, one of the sons of Pañcarāja, performs the daily worship. The anniversary worship of the Bāhāḥ is performed on the 3rd day of the bright fortnight of Pālguna. Similarly, the anniversary worship of the Dharmadhātu Maṇḍala of the courtyard is performed on the 8th day of the bright fortnight of Kārttika. On the 13th day of the bright fortnight of Bhādra (during Indrajātrā) a statue of Yamāḥdyaḥ (Indra) is displayed in the courtyard andsamaybajiis distributed to the elders of Ikhāchẽ Bāhāḥ (Suvarṇa Vihāra).
description_ne: इखाछेँ टोलमा रहेको यो बाहा: निजी बाहा: हो । यो बाहा: हिरण्यवर्ण महाविहारको शाखा विहारको रूपमा रहेको इखाछेँ बाहा: (LAL0950) को एक संघ-सदस्य बेखादेव वज्राचार्यले नेसं ७९८ मा स्थापना गरेका थिए । यी बेखादेव आल्को हिति स्थापना गर्ने तुहूदेव वज्राचार्यका सन्तान हुन् । तुहूदेवका सन्ततिहरूको अंशबण्डा हुँदा तीनजना दाजुभाइको भागमा तीनवटा अलग-अलग सम्पदा परेका थिए । एकजनाको भागमा आन बाहा: र त्यसको जग्गा, एकजनाको भागमा आल्को हिति र त्यसको जग्गा, एकजनाको भागमा आगम देवता र त्यसको जग्गा परेको थियो । जसको भागमा आन बाहा: परेको थियो उनैका सन्ततिहरूले नै अहिलेसम्म बाहा: संचालन गर्दै आइरहेका छन् ।यस आन बाहा:को द्य:छेँ पूर्वाभिमुख गरी दुई तलाको बनाइएको छ । छानामा जस्तापाता राखी सिमेन्टको चैत्यलाई गजूरको रूपमा स्थापना गरिएको छ । गजूरमाथि धातुको झण्डा राखिएको छ । छानाको भार थाम्न सादा टुँडालहरू राखिएका छन् । द्य:छेँको पहिलो तलामा तीनवटा झ्यालहरू छन् र प्रत्येक झ्यालमाथि माटोले बनाइएको तोरण छ । बीचमा रहेको झ्यालमाथि पहिले धातुको पाताले मोडिएको तोरण राखिएको थियो (Locke1985, 50) । द्य:छेँको भुइँतलामा गर्भगृह रहेको छ । गर्भगृहभित्र पूर्वाभिमुख गरी अक्षोभ्यलाई क्वा:पा:द्य:को रूपमा स्थापना गरिएको छ । गर्भगृहभित्र जाने सिँढीको दायाँ-बायाँ एक जोडी ढुंगाको सिंह राखिएको छ । गर्भगृहभित्र पस्ने ढोकामाथि काठको तोरण छ । पुरानो तोरण चोरी भएपछि नेसं ११०० मा नयाँ तोरण बनाएर चढाइएको हो । तोरणको बीचमा अक्षोभ्य र उनको माथि पञ्चबुद्ध छन् । ढोकाको दक्षिणमा गणेश र उत्तरमा महाकालको मूर्ति राखिएका छन् । बाहा: प्राङ्गगणमा एउटा अशोक चैत्य स्थापना गरिएको छ । यो चैत्य बाहा: स्थापना हुनुभन्दा अघि नै अस्तित्वमा थियो र नेसं ७७७ मा चैत्यको जीर्णोद्धार गरिएको थियो । अशोक चैत्यको पूर्वमा धर्मधातु मण्डल र मञ्जुश्री पादुका पनि स्थापना गरिएको छ ।अहिले यो बाहा: बेखादेवका सन्तानहरूले सञ्चालन गरिरहेका छन् । बेखादेवका सन्तानमध्ये पञ्चराज वज्राचार्यका छोरा संघरत्न वज्राचार्य एक्लैले बाहा:को जिम्मा लिई नित्यपूजा चलाइरहेका छन् । प्रत्येक वर्ष फागुन शुक्ल तृतीयाको दिनमा बाहा:को वर्षबन्धन गरिन्छ । कार्त्तिक शुक्ल ८ को दिनमा बाहा: प्राङ्गणमा रहेको धर्मधातु मण्डलको वर्षबन्धन गरिन्छ । त्यस्तै भाद्र शुक्ल १३ इन्द्रजात्राको दिनमा बाहा: प्राङ्गणमायमा:द्य:(इन्द्र) प्रदर्शन गरी इखाछेँ बाहा: (सुवर्ण विहार) का आ:जुहरूलाई समय्‌बजि वितरण गरिन्छ ।

historical_events.event_description: A newtoraṇawas fixed on top of the entrance to the sanctum sanctorum after the old one was stolen. The name of the donor could not be deciphered, but according to the locals it was donated by Cakrarāja Śākya.

There are no historical records regarding the foundation of the Aśoka Caitya. However, a damaged inscription records that the Caitya was renovated in NS 777. The name of the person responsible for this is not legible, as the letters are broken in many places.
Viśvavajra Vajrācārya established this Dharmadhātu Maṇḍala together with his two sons Pañcavajra Vajrācārya and Hevajra Vajrācārya and daughters Nanda Kumārī, Dhana Kumārī and Rīti Kumārī.

The name of the donor is not recorded, but according to the locals Viśvavajra Vajrācārya established the Mañjuśrī Pādukā. The donor has arranged for the anniversary worship of this Pādukā to take place on the 8th day of the bright fortnight of Kārttika, on the day of death of his mother Gyana Thakuṃ.
The Bāhāḥ collapsed in the earthquake of 1934 and was rebuilt by the descendants of the founder.

historical_events.event_name: Replacing jhiṅgati roof with zinc sheet
historical_events.event_description: The family of Viśvavajra Vajrācārya replaced the oldjhĩgaṭī-tiled roof with zinc sheets.
Bekhādeva Vajrācārya built Āana Bāhāḥ and enshrined the statue of Akṣobhya. He bestowed land worth fourropanisand fourānāsto fund religious activities related to the Bāhāḥ.
